page.overview:
What is Meowscarada?

Meowscarada resembles an anthropomorphic feline with light green fur covering its main body, with the exception of its dark green legs. It has a pink floral collar around its neck, a dark green appendage that resembles a mask with green diamond motifs and a black and green scarf like appendage. It has pink eyes, a triangular nose and a short tail. It is often accompanied by a four-petaled green flower.

Its alternate coloration has its pink appendages become purple and the dark green becoming black.

Meowscarada are shown to be quite stealthy, using pollen-filled flower bombs to catch opponents unaware. They are in fact sneaky and sly magicians that enjoy skillfully misdirecting their foes to give themselves the advantage.

Meowscarada is a prideful and hypersensitive Pokémon that has a tendency to show off. This behavior often results in any Meowscarada becoming very attached to its trainer, as well as having a sour disposition towards other Pokémon that steal its spotlight.
